title: The Life of Flavius Josephus — section 75
creator: Flavius Josephus
date: late 1st century CE work; Perseus English translation
provenance: Perseus Digital Library edition of Josephus's autobiographical Life, section 75.
notes: Josephus states that he was sent together with Titus to the siege of Jerusalem and describes what followed after the city was taken.
Autobiographical testimony supports presence; it is still self-testimony and should be read critically.
